name: More Carriage Routes
summary: Add more routes option to carriage driver
description:
As a dedicated survival mode player, finding the perfect carriage mod has always been a challenge. While there are many excellent carriage mods available, most introduce additional objects or dependencies, leading to compatibility issues and a patching nightmare. After much searching, I discovered [Wait Carriage in Inns](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/83044), which was almost exactly what I was looking for—except it left the vanilla carriages feeling incomplete, as they didn’t benefit from the expanded routes the mod introduced.

To address this, I strip down Edryu Carriage mod to integrates the additional routes same as provided by Wait Carriage in Inns into the vanilla carriages, ensuring they are providing a consistent travel experience across Skyrim.

- New Routes -
Darkwater Crossing
Dragon Bridge
Ivarstead
Karthwasten
Kynsgrove
Morthal
Old Hroldan
Riverwood
Rorikstead
Shor's Stone
Stonehills
Hearthfire Homes

- Compatibility -
not compatible with other carriage mod

- Credit -
Edryu for More Carriages - Fast Travel Improvement
